verdict.rationale: The OCR model page links to a first-party playground ("Try in playground"), so a web way to try the OCR model before writing code appears to exist. Nothing describes what that playground does: no drag-and-drop upload, and no rendering of parse or extraction output such as markdown, tables, blocks or annotations. missing for 10: documentation of drag-and-drop document upload in the playground, evidence that parse/extract results (OCR markdown, annotations, structured JSON) are displayed there, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the playground workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I drag a document into a web playground and see parse/extract results before writing any code
